What We Do

Specialized
Services

Precision metal craft for residential, commercial, and industrial needs — delivered on time, built to specification.

01
S.S. Railings

Stainless steel railings for stairs, balconies, and corridors — modern and durable designs.

02
Ornamental Gates & Grills

Custom decorative gates, window grills, and artistic ironwork for homes and compounds.

03
Rolling Shutters

Heavy-duty manual and motorized rolling shutters for shops and warehouses.

04
Collapsible Gates

Space-saving collapsible gates and shutter gates, ideal for storefronts and parking areas.

05
Sliding Doors

Smooth, robust steel-framed sliding door systems for industrial and residential use.

06
Truss Work & Erection

Industrial truss fabrication, shed erection, and structural steel solutions with site support.

07
Casting Railings

Cast iron railings in vintage and modern patterns — high strength, long-lasting finish.

08
Casting Gates

Ornamental cast iron gates, fully customized for villas, bungalows, and compounds.

Why Choose Us

Built on
Experience

Two decades of craftsmanship backed by quality materials, in-house manufacturing, and direct owner involvement on every project.

  • Precision Design
    Custom measurements and CAD drawings for every order — no guesswork, no rework.
  • On-site Erection
    Complete installation and erection support for truss, gate, and railing work.
  • Premium Materials
    High-grade S.S., M.S., and cast iron with anti-rust coating for long-term durability.
  • Direct Owner Access
    Reach K. Shiva directly for quotes, urgent jobs, or any post-installation concerns.
